A bar magnet is located directly above the middle of the two conductor rings, and the arrow indicates that the magnet approaches the horizontal plane downward along the vertical direction, but does not touch the plane. method.method_draft: 先从图中确定几何关系：导体环a在左、b在右，二者位于光滑绝缘水平面上，条形磁铁在两环正中上方沿竖直方向向下靠近。由题干知道两环是闭合导体且可在水平面上无摩擦移动，磁铁不接触平面。应用楞次定律：磁铁靠近时，穿过每个导体环的磁通量增大，环中产生感应电流，其磁场总要阻碍这种磁通量的增加，等效表现为每个环受到磁铁的排斥作用。由于磁铁位于两环正中，排斥力的水平分量对a指向左、对b指向右；竖直分量由支持力平衡，不影响水平运动。因此a、b将向相反方向运动，即相互远离。

Image description: In the figure there is a smooth insulated horizontal plane, on which two closed conductor rings that are very close to each other are placed, the left one labeled a and the right one labeled b. A bar magnet is located directly above the middle of the two conductor rings, and the arrow indicates that the magnet approaches the horizontal plane downward along the vertical direction, but does not touch the plane.

Reasoning: When the magnet approaches downward, the magnetic flux through each conductor ring increases. According to Lenz's law, an induced current will be produced in the conductor rings, and the magnetic field produced by the induced current will hinder the increase of magnetic flux, so each conductor ring equivalently receives a repulsive action from the magnet. Since the magnet is exactly in the middle of a and b, the repulsive force has a leftward horizontal component on a on the left side and a rightward horizontal component on b on the right side; the vertical component is balanced by the supporting force and does not affect horizontal motion. Therefore the two conductor rings move in opposite directions.
